fact: The ministry's Health Information System Guidelines of May 2019 state that MTUHA (the HMIS) collects data from health facilities and villages while national, zonal and specialised hospitals and private hospitals use different data collection platforms, and that each facility's aggregated data is entered into DHIS in some health facilities, or at the council level where facilities use a paper-based system.
title: Health Information System Guidelines
publisher: Ministry of Health, Community Development, Gender, Elderly and Children
